evals.name: add-toggle-component
evals.prompt: I need to add the toggle component from Spartan to the project. Can you set that up?
evals.expected_output: Runs `npx ng g @spartan-ng/cli:ui toggle` from Homestead.WebApp/, then adds the tsconfig.json path alias. Does NOT use --directory flag.

evals.name: reinstall-select
evals.prompt: The select component is acting weird after we bumped the Spartan packages. Can you reinstall it fresh?
evals.expected_output: Deletes the existing select directory under the componentsPath, then re-runs `npx ng g @spartan-ng/cli:ui select` from Homestead.WebApp/. Does NOT re-add the tsconfig alias since it already exists.

evals.name: run-healthcheck
evals.prompt: We just updated @spartan-ng/brain and @spartan-ng/cli to the latest version. Can you run the Spartan health checks and fix anything that comes up?
evals.expected_output: Runs `npx ng g @spartan-ng/cli:healthcheck` (or with --autoFix) from Homestead.WebApp/. Suggests re-installing helm components if needed.
